options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect

Hence Option C is correct.
Hence, option (A) is correct.

network is developed in the industrialized region west
of the Urals with Moscow as the hub. The important Moscow-Vladivostok

geographical area, highways in Russia are not as important as railways. In

major cities such as Tsungtso (near Vietnam boundary), Shanghai (central
